Jaggers Menu: Your Ultimate Guide to Tasty Dishes and Combos

Jaggers is a fast-casual restaurant that offers a delicious variety of freshly made burgers, salads, chicken sandwiches, and shakes. Known for its scratch-made ingredients and flavorful combos, Jaggers menu provides something for everyone, whether you’re in the mood for a classic burger, a hearty salad, or one of their sweet and creamy shakes. With locations in Louisville and beyond, Jaggers ensures that customers can enjoy their meals both in-restaurant and through delivery or takeout. This guide will give you an in-depth look at the Jaggers menu, including pricing, popular items, and online ordering options to help you make the most of your dining experience.

Jaggers Menu Overview

The Jaggers menu features a wide variety of dishes designed to cater to all tastes, from crispy chicken sandwiches to fresh salads and indulgent milkshakes. Whether you’re looking for a quick bite or a full meal, the menu offers great value with high-quality, scratch-made food options. The restaurant is known for using fresh ingredients, and all items are prepared to order, ensuring maximum flavor and satisfaction.

Burgers: Made Fresh and Full of Flavor

At the heart of the Jaggers menu is their burgers, known for their juicy patties and freshly prepared toppings. Whether you’re in the mood for a classic cheeseburger or something a bit more indulgent like a bacon cheeseburger, Jaggers has a variety of options to suit every craving.

Popular Burger Options:

  • Crazy Good Cheeseburger: A classic cheeseburger topped with melted American cheese, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and house-made sauce, served on a toasted bun.
  • Bacon Cheeseburger: A flavorful burger with crispy bacon, American cheese, lettuce, tomato, and sauce, making it a perfect choice for bacon lovers.
  • Double Cheeseburger: For those with a bigger appetite, this burger comes with two patties, two slices of cheese, and all the fixings.

Burger Pricing Table

Burger Options Price
Crazy Good Cheeseburger $5.99
Bacon Cheeseburger $6.99
Double Cheeseburger $7.49

Chicken Sandwiches: Crispy or Grilled

If you’re a fan of chicken sandwiches, Jaggers offers both crispy and grilled chicken options, each prepared with fresh ingredients and served on a toasted bun. Their chicken sandwiches are made-to-order, ensuring they are always hot, juicy, and flavorful.

Popular Chicken Sandwiches:

  • Crispy Chicken Sandwich: Hand-breaded and fried to perfection, served with lettuce, tomato, pickles, and house sauce.
  • Grilled Chicken Sandwich: A lighter option featuring a juicy grilled chicken breast with lettuce, tomato, and sauce.
  • Buffalo Chicken Sandwich: Crispy chicken tossed in buffalo sauce for a spicy kick, topped with lettuce and ranch dressing.

Chicken Sandwiches Pricing Table

Chicken Sandwich Options Price
Crispy Chicken Sandwich $6.29
Grilled Chicken Sandwich $6.29
Buffalo Chicken Sandwich $6.49

Salads: Fresh and Healthy Options

For those seeking something lighter, Jaggers salads are packed with fresh ingredients and vibrant flavors. These salads are made with a variety of toppings and dressings, offering a healthy and satisfying meal without compromising on taste.

Popular Salad Options:

  • Grilled Chicken Salad: A bed of mixed greens topped with grilled chicken, tomatoes, cucumbers, shredded cheese, and croutons, served with your choice of dressing.
  • Crispy Chicken Salad: Similar to the grilled chicken salad, but with crispy fried chicken tenders for added crunch.
  • Blueberry Almond Salad: A refreshing salad with fresh blueberries, almonds, and crumbled bleu cheese, tossed with a light vinaigrette dressing.

Salad Pricing Table

Salad Options Price
Grilled Chicken Salad $7.99
Crispy Chicken Salad $7.99
Blueberry Almond Salad $8.49

Sides: The Perfect Companion to Any Meal

No meal is complete without the perfect side dish, and Jaggers offers a variety of tasty options that pair well with their burgers, chicken sandwiches, and salads. From crispy fries to sweet treats, the sides are just as fresh and flavorful as the main courses.

Popular Sides:

  • Shoestring Fries: Thin, crispy fries seasoned to perfection.
  • Sweet Potato Fries: A healthier option with a hint of sweetness, these fries are a customer favorite.
  • Onion Rings: Crispy, golden onion rings served with a side of house sauce for dipping.

Sides Pricing Table

Side Options Price
Shoestring Fries (Small) $2.99
Sweet Potato Fries (Small) $3.49
Onion Rings $3.99

Shakes: Sweet and Creamy Indulgence

No meal at Jaggers is complete without one of their famous shakes. Made with real ice cream and blended to a creamy consistency, these shakes come in classic flavors that are sure to satisfy any sweet tooth.

Popular Shake Flavors:

  • Vanilla Shake: A rich and creamy classic, made with real vanilla ice cream.
  • Strawberry Shake: Fresh and fruity, this shake is made with real strawberries and blended to perfection.
  • Oreo Shake: A fan favorite, this shake is blended with Oreo cookies for a deliciously sweet and crunchy treat.

Shakes Pricing Table

Shake Options Price
Vanilla Shake $3.99
Strawberry Shake $4.29
Oreo Shake $4.49

Kid’s Menu: Meals for the Little Ones

Jaggers also offers a dedicated kid’s menu, perfect for younger diners. Each kid’s meal comes with a smaller portion of a main dish, a side, and a drink, making it a great option for children.

Popular Kid’s Menu Items:

  • Kid’s Cheeseburger: A small cheeseburger with American cheese and all the fixings, served with a side of fries.
  • Kid’s Chicken Tenders: Two crispy chicken tenders served with a choice of dipping sauce and fries.
  • Kid’s Grilled Cheese: A classic grilled cheese sandwich with melted American cheese on toasted bread.

Kid’s Menu Pricing Table

Kid’s Menu Options Price
Kid’s Cheeseburger $4.99
Kid’s Chicken Tenders $4.99
Kid’s Grilled Cheese $4.49

Ordering Jaggers Online: Quick and Convenient

Ordering from Jaggers is easy and convenient thanks to their online ordering system. Whether you want your meal delivered or prefer to pick it up at your local restaurant, Jaggers offers multiple ways to get your favorite dishes quickly.

How to Order Jaggers Online:

  1. Visit the Jaggers website or download the mobile app.
  2. Browse the menu and select your favorite items.
  3. Choose between delivery or pickup options.
  4. Customize your order, adding extra toppings, sides, or sauces as desired.
  5. Complete your order and track your order in real-time.

Delivery Fee: Delivery fees typically range from $2.99 to $5.99 depending on your location and delivery platform used.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Can I order Jaggers online?

Yes, you can easily order Jaggers online through their website or mobile app, with both delivery and pickup options available.

2. What are the most popular items at Jaggers?

Some of the most popular items include the Crazy Good Cheeseburger, Crispy Chicken Sandwich, and Oreo Shake.

3. Does Jaggers offer vegetarian options?

While the menu is primarily focused on meat-based items, Jaggers salads can be customized to suit vegetarian preferences by removing the meat and adding extra vegetables or cheese.

4. Is there a kid’s menu at Jaggers?

Yes, Jaggers offers a variety of kid-friendly options such as the Kid’s Cheeseburger, Kid’s Chicken Tenders, and Kid’s Grilled Cheese.

5. What are the delivery fees for ordering online?

Delivery fees for Jaggers typically range from $2.99 to $5.99 depending on your location and the delivery platform used.

Restaurant Timings

Most Jaggers locations operate with the following general hours:

  • Monday to Saturday: 10:30 AM – 9:30 PM
  • Sunday: 11:00 AM – 9:00 PM

Check your local Jaggers restaurant for specific hours, as they may vary by location.

With this detailed guide to the Jaggers menu, you now have all the information you need to enjoy a delicious meal from this popular fast-casual restaurant. Whether you’re craving a juicy burger, a crispy chicken sandwich, or a fresh salad, Jaggers offers something for everyone. Don’t forget to indulge in one of their signature shakes to complete your meal!
